title: Clinical and immunological significance of FOXO1 as a biomarker of improved response to immune checkpoint plus tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.
authors: Du, Lingzhi; Wang, Jiahao; Wang, Ying; Wang, Hang; Xu, Xianglai; Wang, Jiajun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FOXO1转录因子在转移性肾细胞癌中作为免疫联合靶向治疗疗效预测生物标志物的临床意义，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作机制、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，仅用随机森林做临床预测，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Predicting response to immune checkpoint inhibitor plus tyrosine kinase inhibitor (IO + TKI) therapy in metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) remains challenging. Forkhead box protein O1 (FOXO1) is a key transcription factor regulating tumor suppression and T cell immunity, but its clinical and immunological significance in RCC is unclear. METHODS: FOXO1 expression was analyzed in TCGA-KIRC, ZS-MRCC, ZS-HRRCC, and JAVELIN Renal 101 cohorts. Associations with tumor grade, stage, survival, and IO + TKI response were evaluated. Immune infiltration and T cell functional states were assessed using immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry. An RF-based machine learning model incorporating FOXO1 and immune-related gene features was developed to predict therapeutic benefit. RESULTS: FOXO1 expression was markedly reduced in RCC tissues and declined with increasing tumor grade and stage. Higher FOXO1 levels were associated with improved overall survival and better IO + TKI response. FOXO1-high tumors exhibited an immune-supportive microenvironment characterized by a trend toward increased cytotoxic CD8(+) T cells, decreased CD4(+) T cells, reduced exhausted T cells, lower macrophage infiltration, and favorable cytokine profiles. High FOXO1 expression also correlated with fewer BAP1 and BRAF mutations. FOXO1 independently predicted greater IO + TKI benefit (p for interaction = 0.019), and the RF risk score integrating multiple immune gene features achieved a more robust treatment interaction (p for interaction = 0.002). CONCLUSION: FOXO1 carries both prognostic and predictive relevance in mRCC and independently predicts greater benefit from IO + TKI therapy. Integration of FOXO1 with complementary immune gene features into an RF-based model provides a promising framework for precision immunotherapy in advanced RCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：在转移性肾细胞癌（mRCC）中，预测免疫检查点抑制剂联合酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（IO + TKI）治疗的反应仍具挑战性。叉头盒蛋白O1（FOXO1）是调控肿瘤抑制和T细胞免疫的关键转录因子，但其在肾细胞癌（RCC）中的临床和免疫学意义尚不明确。方法：在TCGA-KIRC、ZS-MRCC、ZS-HRRCC和JAVELIN Renal 101队列中分析了FOXO1表达。评估了其与肿瘤分级、分期、生存及IO + TKI反应的相关性。使用免疫组织化学和流式细胞术评估了免疫浸润和T细胞功能状态。开发了一种基于随机森林（RF）的机器学习模型，整合FOXO1和免疫相关基因特征以预测治疗获益。结果：FOXO1表达在RCC组织中显著降低，并随肿瘤分级和分期增加而下降。较高的FOXO1水平与改善的总生存期和更好的IO + TKI反应相关。FOXO1高表达肿瘤表现出免疫支持性微环境，其特征为细胞毒性CD8(+) T细胞趋于增加、CD4(+) T细胞减少、耗竭T细胞减少、巨噬细胞浸润降低以及有利的细胞因子谱。高FOXO1表达还与较少的BAP1和BRAF突变相关。FOXO1独立预测更大的IO + TKI获益（交互p值 = 0.019），而整合多种免疫基因特征的RF风险评分实现了更稳健的治疗交互作用（交互p值 = 0.002）。结论：FOXO1在mRCC中兼具预后和预测相关性，并独立预测IO + TKI治疗的更大获益。将FOXO1与互补免疫基因特征整合到基于RF的模型中，为晚期RCC的精准免疫治疗提供了有前景的框架。
